title: Normalize Note Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize note/plugin/rs/** to the Consistency Contract: rename NoteApp -> NotePlayApp (app id "note-play"), adopt PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/selection_ids/PanelTreeBuilder) for the document tree panel, adopt Terminology (app_labels! macro / resolve_labels / localized_label_map / AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled NoteLabels struct and manual overlay construction, adopt Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local test scaffolding, fix region markers/order (Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> NotePlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests), confirm resource_kind and single-app flat layout. Do not touch the prior Wave-1 wire-contract/action-id/stroke-tag rename already done here.
summary:
Normalized note/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract.

C1 naming: renamed the app struct NoteApp -> NotePlayApp (app id "note-play" string unchanged). Zero residual references confirmed via repo-wide grep.

PanelKit: rewrote block_tree_item and the document-tree toolbar/placeholder items on top of tree_item_with_action/tree_item (icon/nested-items/draggable/is_hidden layered via struct-update syntax), and rebuilt render_document_panel on PanelTreeBuilder (.section/.selected/.selection_change/.build) instead of a hand-rolled UiNode::Tree(UiTreeNode{..}) literal; replaced the inline setSelection ids-array parse with the shared selection_ids(args) helper.

Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled NoteLabels struct + NOTE_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + note_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels! generating NotePlayLabels; all call sites switched to resolve_labels::<NotePlayLabels>(view_state) and NotePlayLabels::EN for the manifest's static default window measures; note_action_labels/note_utility_labels kept their (id,en,de) tables but now build the map via localized_label_map; app_labels() rewritten as an AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent chain instead of a manual struct literal.

Testkit: removed local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() scaffolding for semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, new_app_with_registry}, and replaced add_block_then_undo_round_trip's body with testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip; every other test kept its own action/probe content, only the meta()/new_app() call sites were repointed.

C2/C3 regions: renamed region NoteApp -> NotePlayApp; split the former single Document region into Types (all struct/enum data shapes incl. NoteOp/NoteDiff/NoteCanvasEvent) and DocumentHelpers (pure helper fns, CanvasEvents nested as a subregion); promoted CommandLabels to a top-level region ahead of Panels; merged the former Scenes/Shell regions as nested subregions inside a top-level Render region. Final order: Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> NotePlayApp -> MediaExport -> MediaImport -> Manifest -> Tests. Tests region marker was already correctly "Tests".

C4/C6: confirmed single-app crate stays flat (no wrapping mod); confirmed no app-to-app plugin dependency in Cargo.toml.

resource_kind: confirmed already correctly declared on the AppBuilder chain (id "2d.note"), no change needed.

Did not touch the prior Wave-1 ink-canvas wire-contract/action-id/stroke-tag rename already present in this file.

Verification: rustfmt --check against the repo's rustfmt.toml shows no more diff than the pre-existing baseline (confirmed by running the same check against the untouched backup copy: 1383 baseline diff lines vs 1335 in the new file — no regression, and the diffs are pure multi-line-vs-single-line struct-literal style predating this change). Brace/paren counts balanced. Exhaustive grep cross-reference of every import against its usage sites (all used; the two single-occurrence names, AppLabelsOverlayExt and PluginApp, are trait imports needed only for method resolution, matching the identical pattern in flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs). Grepped the whole note/ directory (Cargo.toml, example/semio.note.json, manifest/blocks.manifest.json, lib.rs) for every renamed identifier: zero residue. Manually cross-checked every PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit call against the real signatures read directly from framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit regions (not guessed). Skipped: a full `cargo check -p note-plugin` did not return output within the wait window — ps showed 10+ concurrent sibling `cargo check` processes (flow-plugin, trinity-plugin, forms-plugin, lowpoly-plugin, cad-plugin, draw-plugin, process-plugin, sequence-plugin, vcs, gis-plugin) contending for the shared build lock, consistent with the documented verification policy; left it running in the background rather than blocking further. No test bodies were actually executed.

Nothing needed flagging for the Wave 4 SDK-primitive audit — every C5-forbidden local mechanism (tree_item*, selection_ids, meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry, hand-rolled Labels struct+resolver, hand-rolled (id,en,de)->label-map body, MemoryBackbone::pair scaffolding) had a directly-usable SDK equivalent; no gaps encountered.
